summary.text: One of the forty-four suitors from Zacynthus in Apollodorus' catalogue — wholly distinct from Halius son of Alcinous, who danced with Laodamas before Odysseus at the Phaeacian games.

story.text: Apollodorus names Halius among the wooers assigned to Zacynthus, listed after Laodicus and before Magnes in Epitome 7.29.
